python3 - <<'EOF'
p='design/T287_EFFECT_FUNCTIONAL_REFACTOR_PLAN.md'
s=open(p).read()
old_status=s.split('\n',3)[2]
assert old_status.startswith('Status: **Phase1A/1B and FOUNDATION-ORACLE-001 accepted')
new_status=("Status: **Phase1A/1B and FOUNDATION-ORACLE-001 accepted for their exact successor sources and selected proofs; Root PHASE2-SCOPE-01 activates the phase2 lifetime/command source slice below on checkpoint `ed17ab14…`; its source is authored, unreviewed and unproved. Phases 3–4 and GC03 remain planned and unactivated.** "
 "Root [PHASE1-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-01](/Users/jim/src/apps/abiogenesis/.ai-workspace/work/T287_RELEASE_RESUMPTION_01/rc11-effect-phase1-01/proof-01/ROOT_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.json) retains the phase1 closure: deterministic 29/29, lifetime 18/18, m5 39/39 and original nine-file unit 96 passes/six declared skips. Root [FOUNDATION-ORACLE-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE-01](/Users/jim/src/apps/abiogenesis/.ai-workspace/work/T287_RELEASE_RESUMPTION_01/rc11-effect-phase1-01/foundation-oracle-proof-01/ROOT_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE.json) accepts native04 source `002e481a…` and whole installed W2-05 3/3 with zero skips on proof archive `fdbf93de…`; that oracle is closed. Those counts are baseline for their exact sources, not evidence for the phase2 successor. Historical failures, six skipped claims, synthetic pending-owner limit and wider qualification obligations remain. Installed old RC11 is unchanged/unqualified/unpublished; RC10 remains pinned. No release is activated.")
s=s.replace(old_status,new_status,1)
old_tail="`FOUNDATION-ORACLE-001` is active for the separate W2-05 collection-token oracle and matching Design sentence; it does not reopen Phase1 proof."
assert old_tail in s
s=s.replace(old_tail,"`FOUNDATION-ORACLE-001` is closed by its own Root acceptance above; it does not reopen Phase1 proof.",1)
anchor="## Phase1 causal proof and retained effects"
phase2='''## Phase2 accepted HOW (PHASE2-SCOPE-01)

Removed responsibilities, decided before source change:

| Displaced mechanism | Selected replacement |
|---|---|
| `createOwnedProcessLifetime`'s seventeen parallel mutable fields (`phase`, `directExit`, `launchFailure`, `firstError`, `scopeAbsence`, `closeObserved`, `streamsDisposed`, `drainExpired`, `cleanupStartedNs`, `scopeDeadlineNs`, `cleanupDeadlineNs`, `probeCount`, `signalAttempts`, `killAttempted`, `completionPublished`) and its mutually re-entrant decision closures `probe`, `signal`, `complete`, `finishScope`, `check`, `startKill`, the decision body of `requestTermination`/`fail`, and the `if (phase !== "term") return` stale-TERM patch | One frozen `OwnedProcessState` and pure `transitionOwnedProcess(timing, state, input, nowNs)` in `shared/owned_process_state.ts`. Each step returns the next state and a finite physical action list (`notify`, `signal`, `probe`, `finalize`); a callback or host probe is always the step's last action and its continuation is a new input decided against the then-current state, so an obsolete TERM/KILL cannot follow re-entrant strengthening or completion. The three wait deadlines are state values. |
| Imperative timer arming inside each closure | The narrow synchronous bridge reconciles the three existing `createMonotonicDeadline` waits from the current state after every step; a fired wait is accepted only while it is still the state's wait. Deadline arithmetic, chunking, stale-arm guards and already-due synchronous action are unchanged. |
| Snapshot recomputation after completion | One frozen facts object is sealed after finite disposal has recorded its synchronous errors and owner error reporting is disconnected; `snapshot()` then returns that same object. Inert stream/child error guards remain until natural close and hold no mutation authority. |
| `runCommand`'s ad hoc `try/finally` coordinator (timeout cancel, heartbeat clear, `activeCommand` reset, capture close and listener removal) and its Promise result | `runCommand` returns one Effect. A Scope owns: the spawned child and lifetime (acquired together; release requests the existing finite cleanup, awaits the lifetime's own completion, then clears `activeCommand`), the unchanged heartbeat interval, and the capture listeners plus command timeout (released only after that physical completion). Ownership precedes fallible listener/timeout setup, whose error remains `lifetime.fail`. No retry, race or Effect timeout is added; Scope interruption is not physical absence. |
| `main`'s Promise sequencing | One helper Effect program, executed once through `runEffectProgram` in `main`; `await main()` stays. Existing async owners are lifted with their original rejection value; only `WorksiteHelperFailure` is caught for D15; the acknowledgment write is drained before the same failure is the program failure; `main` rethrows the squashed original cause. |

HTTP `oneHttpRequest`/`runHttpProbe` bodies, `worker_transport`, `shared/process`, `shared/effect_definition`, the SIGTERM/SIGINT `process.exit` emergency boundary (ordinary finalizers do not run through it), Product, schemas and admission/replay stay unchanged.

'''
assert anchor in s
s=s.replace(anchor,phase2+anchor,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "Phase2 accepted HOW\|FOUNDATION-ORACLE-001" design/T287_EFFECT_FUNCTIONAL_REFACTOR_PLAN.md
